subject: Thank you for finding us first
paragraphs: Thank you for being one of the very first to find ATTENUA.
You don't adapt to AI. AI adapts to you. That's the ATTENUA promise. We're building an AI that never rushes you, moves at your pace, and comes to know and help you better as time goes on.
quote: The more time we share, the better it can protect and help you.
Even in quiet moments, the connection carries on.
after: We'll let you know first when we're ready. Thank you for waiting.
